description: West Pharmaceutical Services, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer in the design and production of technologically advanced, high-quality, integrated containment and delivery systems for injectable drugs and healthcare products. Its products include a variety of primary proprietary packaging, containment solutions, reconstitution and transfer systems, and drug delivery systems, as well as contract manufacturing, analytical lab services and integrated solutions, and its customers include leading biologic, generic, pharmaceutical, diagnostic and medical device companies in the world, with its top priority being delivering quality products that meet the exact product specifications and quality standards customers require and expect, and its business operations are organized into two global business segments, Proprietary Products and Contract-Manufactured Products.
